headline: Real Sociedad's heavy week meets a Levante side scoring again
summary: Real Sociedad arrive fifth in La Liga on 16 points, after a 5-2 win at Málaga on Sunday — but the week is not simple. They play Lillestrøm in Norway in the Europa League on Thursday, three days before Levante visit. Levante come with a 3-1 home win over Athletic Club in midweek, and Brugué has 5 league goals. Their problem is defence: 2.42 expected goals conceded per game. The market still makes Real Sociedad 55.1% favourites across 10 bookmakers, rated 0.75 goals better, with a 3.0 goals line and Over at 48.1%.
read: Real Sociedad are clear home favourites at 55.1%, fifth in La Liga and 5-2 winners at Málaga on Sunday. Levante arrive on the back of a 3-1 win over Athletic Club, but the market sets the total at 3.0 goals and makes them more than twice as unlikely to win.

facts.fact: Real Sociedad are priced at 55.1% to win at home, more than twice Levante's 21.8%.
facts.meaning: The market makes the home side clear favourites — more likely than not to take the three points.

facts.fact: Real Sociedad sit fifth in La Liga with 16 points from nine games.
facts.meaning: They start the weekend as the higher-placed, better-performing team in this fixture.

facts.fact: Real Sociedad won 5-2 at Málaga on Sunday in La Liga.
facts.meaning: Four goals away from home and three points — the best possible preparation for this game.

facts.fact: Levante beat Athletic Club 3-1 at home last night in their game in hand.
facts.meaning: They arrive with a win behind them, three days before travelling to San Sebastián.

facts.fact: Roger Brugué scored twice against Athletic Club to reach five league goals this season.
facts.meaning: Levante's main scoring threat arrives in his best form of the campaign.

facts.fact: Real Sociedad travel to Lillestrøm in the Europa League on Thursday, three days before this match.
facts.meaning: A European away trip in the middle of the week means rotation and tired legs are a real possibility on Sunday.

facts.fact: The handicap line is Real Sociedad -0.75, with a fair line of -0.74.
facts.meaning: The market rates them about three-quarters of a goal better; a one-goal win only half pays the line, two goals pays it in full.

facts.fact: The total-goals line is 3.0, with Over priced at 48.1%.
facts.meaning: The market expects an open game but leans narrowly towards under three goals.

sources.fact: Real Sociedad beat Málaga 5-2 at La Rosaleda in LaLiga.
Mundo Deportivo reports that Real Sociedad have climbed to fifth in LaLiga after their win at La Rosaleda and are now threatening the top sides.
Mundo Deportivo reports that Sunday's display at La Rosaleda eased doubts and lowered tensions around Pellegrino's side ahead of a week of opportunities.
Real Sociedad are due to play Lillestrøm away in the Europa League on Thursday before facing Levante, according to Mundo Deportivo.
Alex Lebarbier is the main new name in Real Sociedad's Europa League squad for the trip to Norway.
Levante beat Athletic Club 3-1 at the Ciutat de València in their LaLiga game in hand.
Roger Brugué reached five goals for Levante with a double against Athletic Club.
Levante went into the Athletic match looking to return to winning ways, according to Yahoo Sports.
